title: Noble Mexican Noodles Horchata
description: Earthy, molten Mexican horchata infused with rice noodles and toasted keto bread for a paleo-friendly adventure.

ingredients.name: toasted keto bread crumbs
ingredients.notes: prepared by toasting a gluten-free keto bread

instructions: Soak the rice noodles in hot water for 5 minutes until softened, then drain and set aside.
In a saucepan, combine coconut milk, banana puree, maple syrup, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, and cacao nibs, and heat over medium heat to 80°C.
Stir the mixture continuously until the cacao nibs are fully dissolved and the sauce is smooth.
Add the drained rice noodles to the saucepan and simmer gently for 2 minutes to allow the noodles to absorb the horchata flavors.
Remove the saucepan from heat and let the mixture cool to 40°C, stirring occasionally to keep the noodles from sticking.
Stir in the toasted keto bread crumbs, chopped almonds, and shredded coconut, mixing until evenly distributed.
Transfer the concoction to serving glasses, allowing it to cool slightly, then elevate to 50°C before serving to enjoy a molten, earthy texture.
Serve immediately and enjoy the adventurous Mexican horchata noodle experience.
